Yeah, AC draws a lot of current and is expensive. Work on ways to insulate your home. Plug any leaks to the outside. Put up thick curtains and close them during the day--especially in sunny spots. Insulate your floors if they're not insulated. Put down rugs if you have hardwood, laminates or tile. Make sure your ducts are insulated. Make sure you have a lot of good insulation in your attic--if not, blow in 12" of insulation up there. Make sure heat is being adequately vented from your attic. Install a ridge vent in your roof if you don't have one, or an attic fan to vent heat outside. Put up a radiant barrier in your attic to reflect UV away from your attic. Make sure your vent registers are unobstructed.
